rubrics.baseline_defect: Options owns Dockerfile-specific platform/tag/path/context and build execution.
rubrics.criterion: Make Dockerfile build preparation/execution a focused responsibility.

Existing Dockerfile.build can own whole workflow. Shared focused services/functions and a thin DockerOptions facade are valid; mutable session state, callbacks or returned data may express the collaboration. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming or moving the same collection of unrelated policies into another catch-all owner is insufficient.
